description: This file defines the DMax class, which implements the DMAX function similar to Excel's DMAX, to compute the maximum value in a database column with conditions.

classes.name: DMax
classes.description: A class that provides a method to calculate the maximum value in a database based on specified criteria, mimicking Excel's DMAX function.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the maximum value in the database column that meets the specified criteria, returning an error or null if the field is invalid.
